dialogues.speaker: Nezhdanov
dialogues.text: Eating these doesn't seem to do much, but everything else I can think of is kind of unhealthy...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What were you thinking of having?

dialogues.speaker: Nezhdanov
dialogues.text: Uh, maybe some milk, some fruit... maybe fries too. And if I could get a Fonta, that'd be perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Nezhdanov
dialogues.text: ...Okay, no. None of that sounds like it's going to fix a bad mood. Who tries to eat healthy when they're in a bad mood? That's just depressing in a different way...

dialogues.speaker: Nezhdanov
dialogues.text: See you. Take care of yourself, and, uh... try to stay in good spirits, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't people usually drink when they're trying to forget their troubles?

dialogues.speaker: Nezhdanov
dialogues.text: I know. But... well, too much alcohol can make you careless. And it's not good for you, either.

dialogues.speaker: Nezhdanov
dialogues.text: I mean, feeling better for a little while isn't worth messing up my health in the long run.

dialogues.speaker: Nezhdanov
dialogues.text: Even if my mood improves now, I'd just end up in worse shape later. That's not much of a trade, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Nezhdanov
dialogues.text: But that all sounds like it would just make me feel more sober, doesn't it? Is that really going to help when I'm in a bad mood? Probably not...

dialogues.speaker: Nezhdanov
dialogues.text: Still, drinking it away would be bad for my health, so I should probably just stick with this...
